assumptions: This is a RETROSPECTIVE dogfood: the companion home iteration was already delivered in the tripdesk product; the layer expresses and verifies it now, driving the LIVE backend (localhost:8002) as the system under test. No product code in tripdesk or mobile-android is changed - by explicit founder constraint (mobile-android is at release). The live journeys are API-level (HTTP against the running backend); a general HTTP/API journey runner as shipped machinery is a noted follow-up, not built here (the driver ships as dogfood evidence under proof/, not as a plugin template, to keep the generic template surface company-free). PLAN-0002's WARP-0201..0204 are retrospective specs of delivered behavior; their proof-of-delivery is the shared live journey suite, not per-spec verdicts.
